text:
Treaties are interpreted in good faith, giving the ordinary meaning of their terms in context and in light of the treaty's object and purpose (VCLT Art. 31(1)). The team note is wrong: object and purpose is not the sole controlling criterion. Text, context and object and purpose are applied together as one combined rule, with the text as the starting point. Supplementary means such as the travaux préparatoires come in only to confirm that meaning, or when it is ambiguous or absurd (Art. 32).

CONFIDENCE: 97
